The n+1 distinct rotation discontinuity arcs and Morse–Hedlund force precisely n+1 positive true words, so H(P_n)<=log(n+1). Each true word has D count k=floor(x+nalpha)-floor(x), |k-nalpha|<1, and exact Markov weight pi_first*a^(n-1-2k+firstD+lastD)*b^(k-firstD). Consequently |log Q_n(w)+nh| is uniformly bounded and overlap=sum_min(P,Q) lies between c exp(-nh) and C(n+1)exp(-nh), yielding exact -log(overlap)/n -> h; cross entropy gives D(P_n||Q_n)=Hb(alpha)+(n-1)h-H(P_n). Independently reconstructed Sturmian cylinder arcs and Markov products for n=10,20,40,80 at irrational alpha, confirming n+1 support and approach of empirical logarithmic overlap rate to h.
